honestyRule: A record may only carry class ANSWERS when a real measured round trip through the deployed service returned HTTP 200 with real answer text. Every other class means exactly what its name says. CONTENDED-TIMEOUT is a measurement of the POOL, not of the model. UNMEASURED means the sweep never reached the model. Nothing in this file is an inference, a projection, or a claim about a model that was not measured.
measuredAtNote: measuredAt is the audit's own stated Date line (date-only, '2026-09-29'), because the audit's per-row table records no per-request timestamp. It is deliberately NOT given second precision: inventing a clock time the sweep did not print is the same defect this file exists to kill. The gate accepts a parseable date and reports the precision.
daemonCommitNote: The audit did NOT record which commit the deployed promptd binary was built from, so daemonCommit is null for every record here and daemonCommitUnknown carries the reason. The repo HEAD at record-writing time is 02577572eefcc0dc6a566fd4ccd54a2c354d86b2 — that is evidence about the WORKING TREE, not about the running daemon, and it is not written into the per-model field for that reason.

daemonCommitUnknown.reason: the 2026-09-29 audit did not record the deployed binary's commit

sourceDiscrepancy: The audit's §1 count table says TIMEOUT=11 and NOT MEASURED=8, but its own §2 row table lists 10 TIMEOUT rows and its §1/§7 NOT MEASURED prose names 11 models one of which (v0) is ALSO a TIMEOUT row. The counts do not close (10+3+10=23 against an advertised 22). This file follows the §2 ROW TABLE, which is the only place the per-model data actually is, and therefore records 1 ANSWERS + 2 SIGN-OUT + 10 CONTENDED-TIMEOUT + 9 UNMEASURED = 22. The audit's own headline numbers are NOT reconciled here and no model was reclassified to make them close.

classes.ANSWERS: a real measured round trip returned HTTP 200 with real answer text from the model's own site
classes.SIGN-OUT: the server returned a NAMED 502/4xx whose own message says sign-in is required (a real, actionable, per-model failure)
classes.CONTENDED-TIMEOUT: a request was issued and got no response (HTTP 000, client abort) while the pool was NOT idle — a measurement of queue contention, NOT a property of the model
classes.UNMEASURED: the sweep never reached this model; nothing is known about it from this run
